Ideal Weight Calculator

Compute ideal body weight from height using the Robinson, Miller, Devine, and Hamwi formulas.

–
Healthy range (kg)

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. These formulas estimate frame-based ideals and ignore muscle mass.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your height in centimeters.
  2. Select your sex.
  3. Press Calculate.
  4. Compare the four formula results and the overall healthy range.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are these formulas?

They estimate a healthy weight from height using slightly different base weights and per-inch factors, originally derived for medication dosing.

Which formula is most accurate?

No single formula fits everyone — that is why all four are shown side by side as a range, not a verdict.

Do they work for short heights?

They are validated for adults around 152 cm and taller; results below that height are extrapolated and less reliable.
